'''The Void''' was a heavy projectile weapon named after a heroic [[Commando/Legends|commando]] in the early wars. It was used by some commandos at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This weapon is a rare loot from the giant [[Wyyyschokk/Legends|webweaver]] spider known as [[Mother Ves'ad]] in the [[Shadowweave Caverns]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It is unknown which "early wars" the item description refers to.
